title: Two Exes Get Snowed In Together, And Ten Years Of Love Come Pouring Out . . . (Us and Them)
caption:
Us and Them (2018): two exes get snowed in at an airport and have to share one hotel room.
A broke couple chased Beijing dreams, and it cost them each other. Follow for more movie recaps!

#usandthem #movierecap #lovestory #netflixmovie #spoilerroom
comment: Was Leo right to chase the money, or was Mia right to leave? Why?

segments.say: After ten years of loving and hurting each other, Leo and Mia finally say a proper *goodbye*.
To see how it got here, go back to a night when the snow shut down a whole *airport*.
Leo and Mia are exes who have not spoken in years, and now they are stuck in the same *crowd*.
The hotel has one room left, so they have to share it.
Neither one can sleep, so they sit in the dark and the past starts *talking*.
It all started on a packed train home, years ago, where two strangers ended up at the same card *table*.
Leo is a quiet student. Mia is a loud girl who drinks, curses, and beats everyone at *cards*.
Then the snow stops the train, and they walk the rest of the way, side by *side*.
Mia's mom is abroad with a new husband, so she spends New Year in an empty *house*.
Leo's dad wants him back home, because there is no career in making video *games*.
So Leo takes her to his dad's table for New Year's Eve, and his dad asks if she is his *girlfriend*.
Walking home in the snow, they both swear they will make it in *Beijing*.
But Beijing had other plans.
Mia works in a computer mall, always smiling, always scraping for something *better*.
She turns up at dinner with a new boyfriend, a government worker with a PhD, and Leo just sits *there*.
It lasts until his mother meets her. Mia has no college degree, and his mom makes sure she *knows it*.
Dumped, Mia shows up at Leo's door with her bags, and the room is so small they can barely *breathe*.
Leo does not fix anything. He just lets her *stay*.
He is kind, but never brave.
To pay the rent, Mia starts selling discs in a cold underpass, and when the inspectors come, she grabs everything and *runs*.
Soon a new man gives her a love hotline, and she tests it by calling Leo across the *tunnel*.
Then, in a huge New Year crowd, the truth comes out. The man has a *wife*.
So Leo and Mia drink away the end of the year in their tiny room, and promise each other it will get *better*.
Back in the hotel, they laugh about their first night together, when she kept one sock *on*.

segments.text: You were only wearing a sock.

segments.say: Then Leo vanished.
Mia knocks on his door, and a neighbor points at a prison wall. Leo got *locked up*.
On New Year's Eve, Mia sits at his dad's table and lies that Leo is stuck at a game *convention*.
When Leo walks out, Mia is waiting, and she admits she told his dad she was his *girlfriend*.
The man with the wife came to her shop and said Leo had beaten him up. Leo only says he *recognized him*.
After prison, Leo starts drawing his own game, about a boy named Ian who cannot find a girl named *Kelly*.
In the hotel, Leo's phone rings, and a little girl asks, where are you, *Daddy*. Leo has a family now, and Mia just listens.
Back then they could not afford a taxi, and Leo promised they would not be poor for *long*.
So he drops his game and sells houses, because he wants to watch her smile when he gets *home*.
Together they carry a giant couch up the stairs, and for once they own something *real*.
Then one New Year he rents a car to drive home, and tells his old classmates his company is about to go *public*.
Then a classmate who is now the mayor's secretary quietly pays the whole bill, and Leo has never felt *smaller*.
Pride always costs more than the dinner.
In the car, Mia says none of it matters to her. Leo hears, you will never make *it*.
He buries himself in a game job, and Mia waits at home with cold *noodles*.
She reads his chats with a girl called Night Elf, and the trust is *gone*.
Then the landlord says move out by tomorrow, and all their things end up on the *street*.
Leo lies to his dad on the phone, says he is eating roast duck in Beijing, while he sits alone in the *dark*.
Mia comes back one last time, leaves him a bowl of noodles, and says, I'm *leaving*.
Leo sprints after her through the subway, but at the last second he does not get on the *train*.
Some trains you only miss once.
Back in the present, Mia says, if you had gotten on that train, I would have stayed with you *forever*.
They trade what-ifs all night. In the end, they have everything. Just not each *other*.
Mia jokes that she could have been the wife, and now she is just the home-wrecker. Nobody *laughs*.
Then the walls come down. I missed you *too*.
Back then, after Mia left, Leo locked himself in a tiny room and poured everything into his *game*.
At the very end of the game he leaves one message, say sorry to Kelly for me if you meet *her*.
Players start leaving apology notes inside the game, and soon there are two *million*.
On TV, the host asks who he wants to say sorry to, and he says, only *her*. Mia is watching, and she cries.
Then he texts her, are you going home this year, and admits he never told his dad they broke *up*.
At his dad's table, the old man's eyes are failing, and Mia gently teaches him how to use the *remote*.
Then Leo says he bought a house in Beijing, and his dad refuses to move, and they scream at each *other*.
Outside in the snow Leo says, I can give you an address in Beijing now. Can't that be called *love*?
Mia says, if you thought I could not survive the hard times then, why think I can live your good life *now*? Leo says he does not understand her.
Later, Leo drives her through the snow, and tells her his dad has *died*.
Mia reads the letter his dad once sent her, and it says that even if they were never a couple, they would always be *family*.
She opens Leo's game one last time, and finds millions of apologies from strangers who lost someone *too*.
Some people you never really *forget*. Wonder what we spoil next?
